verdict.rationale: Kintsugi exposes a broad REST API and five official SDKs generated from an OpenAPI spec. The API covers the core objects: transaction sync, tax estimates, credit notes, nexus, registrations, filings, exemptions with certificate upload, and address suggestions. However, the docs never claim full UI parity, and some workflows are documented as in-app only: API keys are created in the app, and data-source connectors are set up by clicking Connect under Data Sources. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API equivalents for key management and connector setup, and independent or hands-on confirmation of coverage.
